name: ALCops 1.3.1 (BCGrokBot, PTE)
description: All rules of ALCops.Analyzers 1.3.1 (ApplicationCop, DocumentationCop, FormattingCop, LinterCop, PlatformCop, TestAutomationCop) with deliberate severities for a per-tenant extension. Enumerated from github.com/ALCops/Analyzers @ bc6ae5ab (the NuGet 1.3.1 source commit). build.sh is STRICT: Warning fails the build like Error; Info is advisory.

rules.justification: [ApplicationCop] Analyzer threw an unhandled exception - Analyzer crashed: surface it so a broken analyzer on Linux never silently stops checking.
[ApplicationCop] DrillDownPageId and LookupPageId property must be defined for tables used in list pages - Lookup/DrillDown pages on list tables.
[ApplicationCop] Single-field primary key requires the NotBlank property - Single-field PK without NotBlank allows blank keys.
[ApplicationCop] Set NotBlank property to false when 'No. Series' TableRelation exists - NotBlank conflicts with No. Series.
[ApplicationCop] Confirm() must be implemented through the "Confirm Management" codeunit - ALCops default.
[ApplicationCop] GlobalLanguage() must be implemented through the "Translation Helper" codeunit - ALCops default.
[ApplicationCop] Use the "Page Management" codeunit instead invoking Page.Run directly - ALCops default.
[ApplicationCop] Install and Upgrade codeunits should have Access set to Internal - ALCops default.
[ApplicationCop] DataPerCompany must be explicitly set on table objects - DataPerCompany default (true) is right for a PTE; explicit setting is noise.
[ApplicationCop] The Caption of permissionset objects should not exceed the maximum length - ALCops default.
[ApplicationCop] All application objects must be covered by a PermissionSet - Every object must be in our permission set or users get permission errors.
[ApplicationCop] Captions must be defined on user-facing objects and controls - User-facing captions required.
[ApplicationCop] Integration events must not be declared in codeunits with Access set to Internal - ALCops default.
[ApplicationCop] DropDown and Brick fieldgroups must be defined - Opt-in: DropDown/Brick fieldgroups make lookups usable.
[ApplicationCop] ToolTip must end with a punctuation - ALCops default.
[ApplicationCop] ToolTip should start with 'Specifies' - ALCops default.
[ApplicationCop] Do not use line breaks in ToolTip - ALCops default.
[ApplicationCop] ToolTip should not exceed 200 characters - ALCops default.
[ApplicationCop] Empty captions should be locked - ALCops default.
[ApplicationCop] Reserve Enum value zero (0) for empty value - Enum value 0 reserved for empty.
[ApplicationCop] Labels suffixed with Tok must be locked. - Tok labels must be Locked or they get translated.
[ApplicationCop] Locked Label must have a suffix Tok. - Opt-in: Locked labels use Tok suffix (pairs with AC0020).
[ApplicationCop] Empty Enum value should not have a Caption property specified. - ALCops default.
[ApplicationCop] Enum value must have non-empty Caption to be selectable in the client. - ALCops default.
[ApplicationCop] Event publisher methods should not be public. - Public event publishers become a contract we never intend to keep in a PTE.
[ApplicationCop] Use the (CR)LFSeparator from the "Type Helper" codeunit. - ALCops default.
[ApplicationCop] Explicitly set AllowInCustomizations for excluded fields - ALCops default.
[ApplicationCop] Use the 'Tok' suffix for token labels. - ALCops default.
[ApplicationCop] Table field must define a ToolTip. - Table field ToolTips (pairs with CodeCop AA0234).
[ApplicationCop] Duplicate ToolTip between page and table field. - No duplicated ToolTips between page and table.
[ApplicationCop] Use return value for better error handling - ALCops default.
[ApplicationCop] Table data access requires explicit object permissions - Explicit table data permissions on objects accessing data.
[ApplicationCop] Unused permission declared - Unused permissions widen access.
[DocumentationCop] Analyzer threw an unhandled exception - Analyzer crashed: surface it so a broken analyzer on Linux never silently stops checking.
[DocumentationCop] Commit() needs a comment to justify its existence - Commit() must be justified.
[DocumentationCop] Writing to FlowFields is not common and requires an explanatory comment - Writing FlowFields must be justified.
[DocumentationCop] Empty statements should be removed or documented - ALCops default.
[DocumentationCop] Public procedures must include XML documentation comments - Public procedures are documented.
[DocumentationCop] XML documentation must match the procedure signature - Docs must match signatures.
[DocumentationCop] Internal procedures must include XML documentation comments - Internal procedure docs: noise for a small PTE.
[DocumentationCop] Public objects must include XML documentation comments - Public objects are documented.
[DocumentationCop] Internal objects must include XML documentation comments - Internal object docs: noise.
[DocumentationCop] An integration or business event must include XML documentation comments - Events are documented.
[DocumentationCop] Internal event must include XML documentation comments - Internal event docs: noise.
[FormattingCop] Analyzer threw an unhandled exception - Analyzer crashed: surface it so a broken analyzer on Linux never silently stops checking.
[FormattingCop] Procedure or Trigger declaration should not end with semicolon - Formatting: trivial to fix, keeps diffs clean.
[FormattingCop] Casing of symbols and keywords must align with the language definition - Keyword/symbol casing.
[FormattingCop] Function calls should have parenthesis even if they do not have any parameters - Formatting: trivial to fix.
[FormattingCop] Permission declarations should be sorted by object type and name - ALCops default.
[FormattingCop] Call methods with parenthesis instead of using assignment syntax - Formatting: trivial to fix.
[FormattingCop] Permission values should be lowercase - ALCops default.
[FormattingCop] Statement blocks should be separated by a blank line - Blank-line style is subjective; not enforced.
[LinterCop] Analyzer threw an unhandled exception - Analyzer crashed: surface it so a broken analyzer on Linux never silently stops checking.
[LinterCop] Do not use Object IDs as object references - Object IDs instead of names break on renumbering.
[LinterCop] Maintainability index metric - Metric only (no finding).
[LinterCop] Maintainability index below configured threshold - ALCops default.
[LinterCop] Cyclomatic complexity metric - Metric only (no finding).
[LinterCop] Cyclomatic complexity exceeds configured threshold - ALCops default.
[LinterCop] Redundant DataClassification on field - ALCops default.
[LinterCop] Redundant ApplicationArea on page - ALCops default.
[LinterCop] Use identifier syntax in event subscriber arguments - ALCops default.
[LinterCop] Use ReadIsolation instead of LockTable - ALCops default.
[LinterCop] App manifest runtime is behind target version - We pin runtime 18.0 to BC 29 on purpose; advisory only.
[LinterCop] Explicitly set the RunTrigger parameter on build-in methods - Implicit RunTrigger hides whether table triggers run.
[LinterCop] Use SecretText type to protect credentials and sensitive textual values from being revealed - Credentials must use SecretText.
[LinterCop] Use Error with ErrorInfo or Label instead of Text - Error() with Text constants loses translation/telemetry; use Label/ErrorInfo.
[LinterCop] The internal method is declared but never used. - ALCops default.
[LinterCop] The internal method is only used in the object in which it is declared. - Internal-but-local procedures are often fine during development.
[LinterCop] Use the standard 'I' prefix for interface object names. - Opt-in: I-prefix for interfaces, matches BCApps.
[LinterCop] Give field more describing name. - ALCops default.
[LinterCop] Use Rec.IsEmpty() for checking record existence - Count() for existence checks is a needless full count.
[LinterCop] Consider using a Query object or Rec.Find('-') with Rec.Next() for checking exactly one record - ALCops default.
[LinterCop] Use new Date/Time/DateTime methods for extracting parts - ALCops default.
[LinterCop] Use the new PageStyle datatype instead string literals - ALCops default.
[LinterCop] Prefer Enum over Option type - Prefer Enum over Option for new code.
[LinterCop] Cognitive complexity metric - Metric only (no finding).
[LinterCop] Cognitive Complexity increment - Metric increment detail only.
[LinterCop] Cognitive Complexity exceeds threshold. - ALCops default.
[LinterCop] Translatable text should be translated - PTE ships en-US only, no translation files (TranslationFile feature just generates the .g.xlf).
[LinterCop] Name does not match naming convention - Naming pattern is unconfigured; advisory until configured.
[LinterCop] Redundant AllowInCustomizations on field - ALCops default.
[LinterCop] Parameter is not referenced - ALCops default.
[LinterCop] Unnecessary record parameter in method call - ALCops default.
[LinterCop] Avoid mixing exit() and named return variable assignments - ALCops default (disabled by default).
[LinterCop] Event subscriber procedure name does not match the configured template - ALCops default.
[LinterCop] Event subscriber parameter is not referenced - ALCops default.
[PlatformCop] Analyzer threw an unhandled exception - Analyzer crashed: surface it so a broken analyzer on Linux never silently stops checking.
[PlatformCop] FlowFields should not be editable - Runtime/data correctness; never acceptable in a PTE.
[PlatformCop] AutoIncrement fields are not supported in temporary tables - ALCops default.
[PlatformCop] Filter operators should not be used in SetRange - ALCops default.
[PlatformCop] Zero index access on 1-based List objects - ALCops default.
[PlatformCop] Explicitly set Extensible property on public objects - Extensible is mostly an AppSource contract concern; advisory in a PTE.
[PlatformCop] Every object needs to specify a value for the Access property - Opt-in: forces a deliberate Access choice; default to Internal in a PTE.
[PlatformCop] Avoids a runtime error from using AutoCalcFields on a field that is not a FlowField or a field of type Blob. - ALCops default.
[PlatformCop] Avoid unsupported operators with placeholders in SetFilter expressions - ALCops default.
[PlatformCop] Event subscriber var keyword mismatch. - Runtime/data correctness; never acceptable in a PTE.
[PlatformCop] Handled parameters in event signatures should be passed by var - Runtime/data correctness; never acceptable in a PTE.
[PlatformCop] Set values for FlowFilter fields using filtering methods - Runtime/data correctness; never acceptable in a PTE.
[PlatformCop] Incorrect number or type of arguments in .Get() method on Record object - ALCops default.
[PlatformCop] Use two single quotes instead of double quotes in JPath expressions - ALCops default.
[PlatformCop] Use IsNullGuid() to check for empty GUID values. - ALCops default.
[PlatformCop] Clear/ClearAll does not reset SingleInstance codeunit state - Runtime/data correctness; never acceptable in a PTE.
[PlatformCop] Page record argument does not match source table - Runtime/data correctness; never acceptable in a PTE.
[PlatformCop] Page record methods require a SourceTable - ALCops default.
[PlatformCop] Invalid single-quote escaping in filter string - Runtime/data correctness; never acceptable in a PTE.
[PlatformCop] Incompatible field types across TransferFields - Runtime/data correctness; never acceptable in a PTE.
[PlatformCop] Inconsistent field names across TransferFields - Runtime/data correctness; never acceptable in a PTE.
[PlatformCop] Possible overflow when assigning text to a smaller target type. - Runtime/data correctness; never acceptable in a PTE.
[PlatformCop] Incorrect 'IsHandled' parameter assignment. - Runtime/data correctness; never acceptable in a PTE.
[PlatformCop] The 'ApplicationArea' property is not applicable to API pages. - ALCops default.
[PlatformCop] The ODataKeyFields property should use the SystemId field. - ALCops default.
[PlatformCop] Mandatory fields must be exposed on API pages. - ALCops default.
[PlatformCop] Avoid triggering table logic on temporary records - Runtime/data correctness; never acceptable in a PTE.
[PlatformCop] Table relation field length mismatch - Runtime/data correctness; never acceptable in a PTE.
[PlatformCop] Use CreateSequentialGuid() instead of CreateGuid() for key fields - ALCops default.
[PlatformCop] Use partial records on read operation - ALCops default.
[PlatformCop] Partial records cause JIT load on full-field operations - ALCops default.
[PlatformCop] Report layout property exceeds maximum length - ALCops default.
[PlatformCop] Duplicate OData EntityName on page controls - ALCops default.
[PlatformCop] Placeholder argument count mismatch - Runtime/data correctness; never acceptable in a PTE.
[PlatformCop] Use SetAutoCalcFields instead of CalcFields inside loops - ALCops default.
[PlatformCop] SetRecord() does not support temporary records - Runtime/data correctness; never acceptable in a PTE.
[PlatformCop] Use Validate() instead of direct field assignment - Validate() vs assignment is contextual (setup/tests assign deliberately); advisory.
[PlatformCop] Not all code paths return a value - Not all code paths return a value.
[TestAutomationCop] Analyzer threw an unhandled exception - Analyzer crashed: surface it so a broken analyzer on Linux never silently stops checking.
[TestAutomationCop] Global procedures in test codeunits must be test methods - Test codeunits: helpers should be local; library codeunits are not Subtype=Test.
